name: Januaria

attributes.attribute: a Continental Celtic goddess known from one healing shrine in Burgundy, shown playing a pipe

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Januaria is a Continental Celtic goddess. Her figure survives at one healing shrine in Burgundy, in southwestern France. The figure shows her playing a pipe. Scholars interpret the pipe as a sign that music was part of her healing rituals.
objective: Document Januaria as a Continental Celtic healing goddess.
key_results: Record her single healing shrine in Burgundy.
Note the pipe figure and its musical interpretation.
evidence: Monaghan, P. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore (2008): Januaria entry.
Green, M. 'The Celtic Goddess as Healer' (1996).
